about_the_game:
Use a lighter and a fuel canister to light your way and burn everything and everyone that stands between you and your goal, because sometimes the only way to survive is to leave behind only ashes.

Every word or sound you make can give you away. Enemies can hear you. Keep this in mind when choosing your tactics.

The toolkit of sound devices that you can buy in the game store can be very useful in the fight against all enemies.

Each player starts the game alone, you don't know where you are, you don't know who you will meet on your way.

In each game session, the city changes its landscape, which guarantees the uniqueness of each passage and makes you rely solely on your intuition when any next turning point could be the last.

name: Obscurity State

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, 64 Bit 64bit OS required
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: For 1080p: Geforce GTX 1650, Radeon RX 5300
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Yes
  • VR Support: No
  • Additional Notes: Mouse, Keyboard, Microphone for team communication

  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: For 1080p: Geforce RTX 3060 Ti, Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection

short_description: "Obscurity State" is an asymmetrical cooperative horror game with rogue-lite elements, in which you and your friends (up to 8 players) choose who they are - marauders who have infiltrated an abandoned city, or mystical hunters who are trying to catch them.
